title: Homebrew NMOS Transistor Step by Step - So Easy Even Jeri Can Do It
summary: Jeri Ellsworth shows step by step how to make an NMOS transistor at home using a kiln, rust remover, spin-on dopant, eBay wafers and vinyl stickers.
why: HN points to it as the classic example of home-made semiconductors and a fun way to go down to the transistor level.

quote.text: If you want to go further down, check out Jeri Ellsworth's old videos where she built a transistor at home
